message: A nutrition target can now be set to Stay under, for something like saturated fat or sugar that you want to keep below a number. The Food log shows how much is left and turns red past the limit, logging a food shows what it will bring the day to, and you can show your limits on Today. Each limit can also be a daily “don’t do” task that names the foods behind the day’s total and logs a slip when you go over, so its streak counts the days you stayed within it. Stats counts those days too, and the meal plan shows what each planned day adds up to.
